sections.title: GPU Computing for Machine Learning Systems
sections.description: In this course, we will explore massively parallel programming, specifically on graphics processing units (GPUs), with immediate application to machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI). We’ll first outline computational aspects of ML and connect parallel programming to common components of deep learning. You will gain proficiency in GPU programming basics through hands-on projects with industry best practices and tools, eventually building up to implementing components of modern neural models. Recommended Prerequisites: ESE 5460. Course projects require knowledge of C/C++. Please note: This course is designed with the expectation that students will need to spend up to $300 on cloud computing resources in addition to tuition. Any expenses beyond this amount are also the responsibility of the student.
